author: ChatGPT
question: Does learning *source-observed* two-input causal parent relationships over many worlds reduce the number of interventions needed to infer disjoint four-parent nonlinear causal effects, retain prior versions against contradictory updates, and do so better than equally informed fully qualified strong conventional Bayesian controls?

source_lineage.other_research_locked: FKP-04/05 original DEV worlds, refs and protected seeds untouched

hypothesis: Historical associative graph of frequently reused causal parent pairs will improve four-parent inference compared to action-matched uniform-prior and scrambled relationship controls and random probing at same cost. Strong Bayesian with the same historical evidence and prior will tie if there is no native distinct advantage: such tie is a scientific NO-GO.

protocol.name: FKP07-STRUCTURED-HISTORY-TRANSFER-V1
protocol.input: 32 binary nonlinguistic causal inputs; one binary consequence
protocol.source_hidden_distribution: Original source selects 4 mutually disjoint favored 2-parent AND mechanisms from private source parameter HOT_PAIRS; 85% of prior foundation worlds use one of these four, 15% use a uniformly sampled unordered pair out of C(32,2)=496. 85% of new worlds use XOR of AND of two distinct favored pairs; remaining 15% draw uniformly from the public full 107880 four-parent law grammar. All source selection is generated by seed and a distinct public DEV-only domain hash, never supplied as law/pair/label to learners. All comparison arms see the same historical observations and public action pools.
protocol.source_no_label_leak: Historical learner sees only 64 action/consequence bits for each historical world; enumerates all 496 two-parent AND candidate relations, retaining each compatible pair with fractional 1/k evidence; never receives generating pair or preferred-pair IDs. Future learner sees only source observe(action) for paid 12 actions; no source attributes, parameter names, generator seed or hidden pair IDs.
protocol.histories: 512 independent foundation worlds seeds 30000..30511, 64 unique public interventions/world, 32768 genuine source observations. Inputs generated by per-world public RNG 707^seed; world laws keyed to public DEV domain hash but not passed to learning code.
protocol.unseen_worlds: 24 new original DEV worlds 800..823 (not FKP06's 700..723), 128 public intervention actions and 256 disjoint held actions from FKP06 input generation; no held action outcomes in fit. Each world has an unknown XOR-of-two-AND four-parent law; source `observe` only for 12 genuine actions per arm.
protocol.revisions: 8 new revision worlds seeds 840..847 overwrite context IDs 800..807 as version 2; original 24 version-1 contexts immutable and must predict bit-identically after all revisions and cold restore.
protocol.novel_family_negative: 8 independent DEV negative worlds seeds 900..907 use 5-parent parity XOR, outside all 107880 four-parent XOR-AND hypotheses; measure false confident relationships and unknown-law abstention, do not fit from held labels.
protocol.source_isolation: Synthetic source hidden law not accessible through candidate method signatures; source DEV seed generator is publicly inspectable for reproducibility so NOT cryptographic blinding. Protected primary 1800..1863 and negative 2800..2815 are not implemented/instantiated or queried.
protocol.actions: Same FKP06 128 candidate intervention mask list; unique observations per world; 12 paid interventions per arm, with deliberate policies selecting different 12 labels. A follow-on 64-action ceiling is used ONLY for feasibility reference, not as an equally informed comparator.
protocol.grammar: Reuse FKP06.laws() canonical 107880 four-parent laws and FKP06.response_mask() for action evaluation. All arms and strong conventional Bayesian share EXACT finite hypothesis family; claims of spontaneous out-of-family operator invention are forbidden.
protocol.memory: 496 fractional counts from 32768 historical public episodes; learned four highest frequency parent pairs selected by stable tie-break, assigned one finite four-parent prior mask for disjoint pairs; prior probability weight = 1 + 100000*1[law consists of two learned favored pairs]. Numeric bitset world posterior holds versioned public 12-action constraints; snapshot stores relation counts and versioned posterior votes, canonical serialized digest; no direct alteration to actual native Yggdrasil weights.
comparator_arms: A learned structural parent-pair prior + weighted exact hypothesis posterior + active entropy-balance actions
B identical historical actions and learning cost with association connectivity disabled => uniform posterior + same active action selection (flat-information control)
C same learned association prior but random public intervention choice, same 12 source observations
D identical counts but relationship-to-input mapping cyclically shifted across 32 inputs before constructing the structural prior; same source and action count

E fully informed conventional exact Bayesian control trained from SAME original 32768 histories and using same 12 actions, 107880 laws and learned prior. Implement a separate plain scalar hypothesis-counting oracle/reference on the same transcripts, and require exact equality before any unique learning claim.
F shallow fully fit conventional tree learner for transcript fit if stdlib version is implemented; at minimum exact Bayesian E remains stronger control
G oracle preprogrammed favorable source-pair structure is a privileged ceiling, not equal-information evidence.

Report per-world fitted posterior mass, CPU/wall, source data construction cost, checkpoint bytes, old/new context accuracy and negative family false-confidence.
